changes.text: We may update this policy if the way the website operates or the legal requirements change. The current version is always available at this address.
changes.title: Changes to this policy

controller.intro: The controller of personal data processed in connection with the use of this website is:
controller.title: Data controller

cookies.text: This website does not use cookies for tracking or advertising. The only information stored locally in your browser is your chosen colour theme (light/dark) and — if you select it in the switcher — the site language, kept in localStorage; it never leaves your device and is not transmitted to us in any way.
cookies.title: Cookies and localStorage

data.form: This website collects personal data only when you provide it yourself — via the contact form. The form asks for: your first and last name, company name, business e-mail address, optionally a telephone number, and the content of your message.
data.noTracking: We do not track or profile visitors on this website — there are no analytics or advertising tools here.
data.title: What data we collect

meta.description: Privacy policy of the govai.pl website — what data we collect through the contact form, on what legal basis and for how long we keep it.
meta.title: Privacy policy — GovAI

purpose.text: We process data from the form solely in order to respond to your enquiry and, where applicable, to prepare a commercial offer — the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (steps taken prior to entering into a contract, at your request) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in conducting business correspondence).
purpose.title: Purpose and legal basis of processing

recipients.text: To handle the contact form we use an external provider, Web3Forms, which forwards messages from the form to our mailbox kontakt@govai.pl. Web3Forms acts here as a processor processing data on our behalf. Apart from this provider, we do not disclose data from the form to any other parties unless required by law.
recipients.title: Who we share data with

retention.text: We keep data from the contact form for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry and the related correspondence, and thereafter — if no further cooperation follows — for a period justified by potential claims. If you would like us to erase your data sooner, write to kontakt@govai.pl.
retention.title: Retention period

rights.access: The right of access to your data and to obtain a copy of it
rights.complaint: The right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO), the Polish supervisory authority
rights.erasure: The right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
rights.howTo: To exercise any of the above rights, write to kontakt@govai.pl.
rights.objection: The right to object to processing
rights.rectification: The right to rectification (correction) of your data
rights.restriction: The right to restriction of processing
rights.title: Your rights

scope: Applies to the govai.pl and govai.pl/blog.html websites.
title: Privacy policy
